notes.title: New Level: The Forest
notes.content:
We're really excited to update Not Without You and implement this new level pack for free! Anyone who purchases (or has already purchased) the game will get the new level pack at no extra charge. It includes 20 challenging new puzzle and 1 brand new world. 

In addition, we've also added new elements to the gameplay to keep the game more exciting. We've added a total-moves counter to keep track of all the moves you make and a 3-star rating system to keep players consistently want to best their previous best.

Right now the new levels and features are only available for PC, but we plan to have a Mac version updated ASAP.

Thank you!
